extraction.teacher_style: The instructor calmly explains weight shifts and positioning while demonstrating with a partner. He breaks down steps into incremental counts and practice segments with music.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to Louisiana Dance Homeschool and Zydeco basics
Demonstration of open and closed positions with music
Instructor introduces himself and partner and explains the footwork
Breaking down weight shifts without rhythm
Practicing basic weight shifts to music
Breaking down the rock step variation
Practicing rock step variation to music
Explaining connection and closed position frame
Practicing closed position basic with rock step to music

common_mistakes: leading step size from the follower instead of the leader

steps_taught.name: Zydeco Weight Shifts
steps_taught.description: Basic weight transfer from one foot to the other.

steps_taught.name: Zydeco Rock Step
steps_taught.description: Basic step incorporating a rock back and forward weight change.

what_works: using inset video window for footwork closeups
progressing from silent weight shifts to full music practice

quotes.text: It's just shifting your weight, you're not really hopping.
The rock step is a led move.
He's going to try to almost like pull her in.
Her hand controls how close you get as far as dancing.
